Source.Name: forgejo-cli
Source.Summary: CLI application for interacting with Forgejo
Source.Description: fj is a CLI client for Forgejo, akin to gh, glab, or tea. It handles Forgejo-specific tasks such as issues, pull requests, repositories, organizations, and releases from the command line, working alongside git.
